name: Gated Two-Block Cut-Vertex Obstruction of Order 587
definition: Translate the certified 294-concept peelable family $P$ by its unique corner so that this corner is $0$, and form the one-point union $X=(P\times\{0\}^{12})\cup(\{0\}^{12}\times P)$ on two disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks.
parameters: $|X|=587$, isometric dimension $24$, VC dimension $3$; deleting its unique cut vertex leaves two components of order $293$.
properties: $X$ is ample, cornerless, and a pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness. Each copy of $P$ is gated in $X$, with the common root as the gate for the other copy. Hence dismantlable ample families are not closed under vertex gluing even when both pieces are gated and peelable.
